lines.beaver: 무슨 일 있어요? 얼굴이 안 좋아요.
lines.beaver_en: Is something wrong? You don't look well.
lines.beaver_roman: museun nil isseoyo? eolguri an joayo.
lines.en: I feel anxious these days. I have a lot of worries.

lines.learner: 고향 친구가 자꾸 생각나요. 너무 그리워요.
lines.en: My friend from home keeps coming to mind. I miss them so much.
lines.roman: gohyang chinguga jakku saenggangnayo. neomu geuriwoyo.

lines.en: Yes, they're the friend I trust the most.

lines.beaver_en: Then you must be really lonely these days.
lines.en: Yes, when I'm alone I feel really lonely.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have many good memories with that friend?
lines.learner: 네, 그 기억을 잊을 수 없어요.
lines.en: Yes, I can't forget those memories.
lines.roman: ne, geu gieogeul ijeul su eopseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: If you're lonely, try contacting that friend.
lines.en: I just called, but they didn't answer.

lines.beaver_en: So that made you feel worse?
lines.en: Yes, I wanted to cry, but I held it in.

lines.beaver: 너무 참지 마세요. 저한테 말해 보세요.
lines.beaver_en: Don't hold it in too much. Try talking to me.
lines.beaver_roman: neomu chamji maseyo. jeohante malhae boseyo.
lines.learner: 고마워요. 지수 씨도 걱정 있으면 말해 보세요.
lines.en: Thanks. Jisu, you try telling me too if you're worried.
lines.roman: gomawoyo. jisu ssido geokjeong isseumyeon malhae boseyo.

lines.beaver: 네, 그럴게요. 친구한테 편지도 써 보세요.
lines.beaver_en: Okay, I will. Try writing your friend a letter, too.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, geureolgeyo. chinguhante pyeonjido sseo boseyo.
lines.en: Good idea. I'll try writing one tonight.

lines.beaver_en: Do you feel a little better now?
lines.en: Yes, I forgot my worries a little. Thank you!
